description: This file declares the MiscService class, which extends ModemService and provides methods for handling IMEI retrieval, time updates, and time zone management within a modem simulator environment.

classes.name: MiscService
classes.description: A class that provides miscellaneous services related to modem simulation, including handling IMEI commands, time updates, and timezone configuration.

methods.name: MiscService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the MiscService instance with service ID, channel monitor, and thread looper.

methods.name: HandleGetIMEI
methods.description: Handles the client request to retrieve the IMEI number.

methods.name: HandleTimeUpdate
methods.description: Handles the client request to update the system time.

methods.name: SetTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the timezone for the service.

methods.name: ParseTimeZone
methods.description: Parses the timezone string into usable form.

methods.name: TimeZoneOffset
methods.description: Calculates the timezone offset in seconds given a UTC time.

methods.name: FixTimeZone
methods.description: Adjusts or formats the timezone string.

methods.name: InitializeCommandHandlers
methods.description: Initializes and returns the list of command handlers.
